users_contact_required_chk.name: users_contact_required_chk
users_contact_required_chk.value: "users"."email" IS NOT NULL OR "users"."phone_number" IS NOT NULL

users_email_normalized_chk.name: users_email_normalized_chk
users_email_normalized_chk.value: "users"."email" IS NULL OR ("users"."email" = lower(trim("users"."email")) AND char_length("users"."email") >= 3)

wifi_sessions_expiry_after_start_chk.name: wifi_sessions_expiry_after_start_chk
wifi_sessions_expiry_after_start_chk.value: "wifi_sessions"."expires_at" IS NULL OR "wifi_sessions"."started_at" IS NULL OR "wifi_sessions"."expires_at" > "wifi_sessions"."started_at"

payments_target_xor_chk.name: payments_target_xor_chk
payments_target_xor_chk.value: ("payments"."wifi_session_id" IS NOT NULL AND "payments"."service_order_id" IS NULL) OR ("payments"."wifi_session_id" IS NULL AND "payments"."service_order_id" IS NOT NULL)
